skills.name: agent-orchestration
skills.description: Divide a large investigation among focused research workers and combine their results. Use when several independent questions can be researched separately.
skills.preview: # Agent Orchestration 1. Define the main question. 2. Create one task per research track. 3. Give each worker its question, scope, source requirements, and output format. 4. Collect the results. 5. Check for duplicate claims and conflicting dates or names. 6. Send unclear results for review. 7. Combine only traceable findings. 8. Write the final report. Each worker returns: **Question**, **Sources**, **Findings**, **Confidence**, **Conflicts**, and **Open questions**. Workers do not silently change the subject, invent tool use, or claim results they did not obtain.
